tests.known_quirk: The drift guard failed twice (manifests 20261022T133924009230Z and 20261022T133951417671Z): the legacy playthrough writes 18 *-slots.json/report files into the project folder, so a run that starts without them sees the source fingerprint change. tests.presentation_windowed_note: Run windowed (without --headless) the same 22 presentation checks pass, but Godot prints 12 exit-time 'Texture ... leaked 349524 bytes' errors and the runner marks the run FAIL (3 of 3 runs). The 0.3.0 release and the builder's runs used --headless, which passes cleanly. Exit-time GL teardown leak, not a gameplay failure; reported, no source change.

observations: Durability: both code4 save slots were 0 bytes after the previous emulator shutdown although the app had written and read back valid slots seconds earlier. Both slots were rewritten within 8 s and nothing forced them to disk, so a hard power-off or emulator kill shortly after a save can lose the whole save. This session ran 'adb shell sync' before shutdown. Not reproduced on a phone.
After Home on a finished catalog1 victory panel, returning shows an extra RESUME button above RETRY ROAD (retry-flow/c1-back-from-home.png). Cosmetic.
On the rule3 defeat panel the surviving crew are drawn inside the evac blockade model (retry-flow/r3-cold-relaunch.png). Cosmetic.
